item.title: Meet Lianna Genovese, 19, whose simple gadget helps people paint again
item.summary: Lianna Genovese, a Canadian student, has created an inspiring device called Guided Hands to assist children with cerebral palsy in expressing their creativity through painting. This innovative tool harnesses arm and shoulder movements, enabling young artists to engage with touch screens effectively. Originally composed of basic materials, Guided Hands has transformed into a recognized commercial assistive technology, earning accolades worldwide for its significant impact.
